Since 2020, we’ve created and powered Externships for over 50,000 students on behalf of companies from Fortune 500s to startups.

Internships are how many college students get this kind of experience, but the demand for good internships outstrips the supply. By making work experience more accessible, Extern is driving the rapid mobility and upskilling needed for a new economy.  We envision a world where anyone can access work experience as a form of education – no matter their background, experience, or socio-economic status.  Come join our movement to reshape work, education, and credentialing for future generations with the Externship.

Extern was born out of a pivot from Paragon One (W17) which initially focused on providing students with a career center-as-a-service platform, connecting them with industry professionals to receive career coaching and guidance.
